titel: Is your model inside out? Find it in 2 clicks 🔴 #blender #3dprinting
printzin: Every printer is different: print a small test first.

scenes.tekst: Is your 3D model secretly inside out? You can check it in two clicks.
scenes.uitspraak: Is your three D model secretly inside out? You can check it in two clicks.
scenes.label: QUICK CHECK

scenes.tekst: Open the Overlays menu and tick Face Orientation.
scenes.label: STEP 1

scenes.tekst: Red means you see the back of a face. It points the wrong way.
scenes.label: WHY

scenes.tekst: The Blender manual says red on the outside most likely needs a flip.
scenes.label: WHY

scenes.tekst: To fix it, press Tab for Edit Mode, then A to select everything.
scenes.label: STEP 2

scenes.tekst: Now press Shift N. Blender turns every face to the outside.
scenes.label: STEP 3

scenes.tekst: No red left. All 96 inward faces now point out.
scenes.uitspraak: No red left. All ninety six inward faces now point out.
scenes.label: RESULT

scenes.tekst: Do this check before every export to your slicer.
scenes.label: TIP

scenes.tekst: Every printer is different, so print a small test first. Save this for your next print.
scenes.label: PRINT FIRST

scenes.tekst: Make your prints poseable: Click Joints Pro, on Gumroad.
scenes.label: CLICK JOINTS PRO
scenes.uitspraak: Make your prints poseable: Click Joints Pro, on Gumroad.
